about: Every named place inside the blue campus boundary of the UG Campus Map (https://enkayyy97.github.io/ug-campus-map/), as captured on 17 October 2026 for the owner's two-part reference PDF (79 zoom-18 sections, street map and satellite): the site's 95 numbered markers (names from the site's own titles; position = the pin) and the 438 OpenStreetMap labels its street map prints (position = the label point; 'tags' is the OSM tag that made it a label). Names cut by the PDF table's wrapping were completed from data/legon.osm or the site's titles. build-master.mjs makes every non-road row a destination unless the game already has that place, and gives a marker's name to the place it matched as a search alias.
